These compounds are all implicated in targeting Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, indicating a possible chain of interactions that could influence the transporter's function. The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanisms and the role of each intermediate compound remain to be fully elucidated. The evidence highlights the potential for Vatiquinone to interact with the transporter through various molecular pathways, underscoring the complexity of the biological network involved.
